vibe_rationale: Long-running NorCal gravel classic with a camp-and-party culture and a strong riding community; small and single-scene.
fit_notes: Adult gravel riders camping overnight, with a clear post-ride recovery and hydration fit and non-endemic precedent (Patagonia, Klean Kanteen). Forty-four listed partners, a partnership page and a named sponsorship contact. The 920 figure counts racers only, so true festival attendance is higher. US-based.
